  ex first_readable([]) == ""
  ex first_readable(["../secret.txt"]) == ""
  ex first_readable(["/etc/passwd", "..", "a/../../b"]) == ""
  with fs = fs.sub("notes")
    for name in names
      var blocked = name.char_count() == 0
      if name.split("\\").len() > 1
        blocked = True
      for part in name.split("/")
        if part == ".."
          blocked = True
        if part == ""
          blocked = True
      if blocked
        continue
      let text = fs.read(name) else continue
      return text
